# TableRow

Table row

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: TableRow

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { TableRow } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<TableRow>
  <TableCell>Cell 1</TableCell>
  <TableCell>Cell 2</TableCell>
</TableRow>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<TableRow>
  <TableCell>Cell 1</TableCell>
  <TableCell>Cell 2</TableCell>
</TableRow>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's TableRow.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI TableRow Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/tablerow/)
